text.answer: Elise switches between human and spider forms, changing her abilities. Spider form gives her melee attacks, extra movement speed, and her stored Spiderling swarm; human form restores ranged attacks and stores the Spiderlings. She starts with the transformation available, and the forms have separate transformation cooldowns.
text.counterplay: Adjust your spacing when she transforms and expect a different set of abilities.
